Title:COMMITTEE OF SUPPLY (Development Estimates)
MPs Speaking:Dr Yeoh Ghim Seng (Mr Speaker);


Column: 969

[Mr Speaker in the Chair]

COMMITTEE OF SUPPLY


    Development Estimates
(Announcement by Mr Speaker)


    Mr Speaker: In accordance with the provisions of paragraph (5) of Standing Order 88 and paragraph (7) of Standing Order 87, I have for the Development Estimates of Singapore for the financial year 1st April, 1972 to 31st March, 1973, fixed the times on the allotted days, namely the 24th and 27th of March. 1972, at which consideration of the heads of expenditure in respect of which amendments stand on the Order Paper Supplement shall, if not previously

Column: 970

disposed of, be concluded. These times have been notified to hon. Members and will appear in the Official Report*.(* Appendix, cols. 1053-4.)
